categories.title: Rest Point
categories.info: Expedition flags allow you to heal, recharge your items, learn new Skills, and allocate your characters' Attribute points.

categories.title: Underwater Treasure
categories.info: Gathering underwater treasure requires Esquie's diving ability, unlocked at Bond level 6 in Act 3.

categories.title: Journal Entry
categories.info: Can be shown to [Berrami](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=475450) in the [Gestral Village](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=448439) for rewards.

categories.title: Lost Gestral
categories.info:
Make a camp in the overworld and speak to Sastro to receive rewards after finding each Lost Gestral. Rewards, in this order, include:
- [Gestral (Maelle Haircut)](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518582)
- [Gestral (Lune Haircut)](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518583)
- [Gestral Sciel Haircut](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518584)
- Paint Break ability / [Colour of Lumina](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=521499)
- [Gestral (Verso Haircut)](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518585)
- [Colour of Lumina x3](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518586)
- [Colour of Lumina x3](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518587)
- [Colour of Lumina x5](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=518588)

categories.title: Paint Cage
categories.info: Destroy all nearby Paint Cage Locks to access the rare loot within.

categories.title: Chroma Catalyst
categories.info: Can be used at Camp to upgrade weapons.

categories.title: Colour of Lumina
categories.info: Can be consumed to give an additional Lumina Point to a character.

categories.title: Recoat
categories.info: Can be consumed to reallocate a character's Attributes or Skill Points.

categories.title: Enemy
categories.info: Most enemies reward you with random loot when defeated.

categories.title: Side Quest
categories.info: WARNING - If you avoid killing any friendly Nevrons and complete all their quests, [Blanche](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=457682) will reward you with **x100 Colour of Lumina**.  If you kill any friendly Nevron or don't complete all Nevron quests, [Blanche](https://mapgenie.io/clair-obscur-expedition-33/maps/the-continent?locationIds=454584) will attack when spoken to.

categories.title: Paint Cage Lock
categories.info: Shoot all three of a Paint Cage's locks to access the loot within.

categories.title: Paint Spike
categories.info: Paint Spikes can be destroyed using the Paint Break skill.  To acquire this skill, find at least 4 Lost Gestrals in the overworld, then speak with Sastro in the Camp
